item.title: Samsung Develops 500-Layer-Plus NAND with 50% More Capacity per Die
item.description:
Samsung has developed a 500-layer-plus NAND flash device, raising per-die capacity from 1Tb to 1.5Tb and areal density by 50%, which implies roughly a 33% cut in cost per bit if die cost holds. The part, likely its 11th-generation V11, is in trial production at Pyeongtaek lines with yields around 30%, targeting commercialization next year and an ISSCC 2027 reveal.

原文标题：三星开发出 500 层以上 NAND 单芯片容量提升 50%

Why it matters：存储层数跨代与单位成本三成的量级变化，直接影响 AI 数据中心的存储成本曲线与三星对 SK 海力士、美光的竞争位次。

item.title: China Unveils Rules for Interoperable Decentralized Digital IDs
item.description:
China's Cyberspace Administration and ten other departments issued rules governing decentralized digital identity registration, issuance and verification on a national blockchain-based identity chain, effective March 1, 2027. The rules cover individuals, organizations and industrial devices, encourage interoperability with digital RMB identities and agent identity labeling, and bar use of identity data for profiling or targeted marketing.

原文标题：十一部门发布分布式数字身份规定 2027 年施行

Why it matters：这是国家级数字身份基础设施的正式落地规则，直接涉及区块链身份链与智能体身份标识，对 AI 身份与合规生态有实质影响。

item.title: UK Completes First Cardless AI Agent Purchase with Papa John's Order
item.description:
The UK has completed its first cardless purchase made by an AI agent, with a Papa John's order placed without sharing bank security details. Conducted inside the FCA's regulated sandbox with Lloyds Bank and payments specialist TrueLayer, the trial demonstrates that agents can transact on a user's behalf.

原文标题：英国完成首笔 AI 智能体无卡支付披萨订单

Why it matters：这是智能体支付落地的首个受监管实证，对关注 AI 商业化的读者具有参考价值。

item.title: China Report Finds Nearly Half of Adults Have Basic AI Literacy
item.description:
China's Cyberspace Administration released its 2026 national digital literacy survey, which for the first time measured AI literacy: 47.46% of adult citizens have basic or higher AI literacy, while only 4.75% reach an advanced level. Overall digital literacy reached 64.69%, up 4.08 points from 2024, with persistent urban-rural and regional gaps.

原文标题：网信办首次调查显示近半数成年公民具备 AI 素养

Why it matters：官方首次给出全国 AI 素养基线数据，是观察中国 AI 普及程度与人才储备的重要宏观参照。

item.title: ByteDance's Doubao Model Powers 80% of Top TV Makers
item.description:
Volcano Engine said its Doubao large model now powers TVs from Skyworth, Changhong, Hisense and TCL, covering 80% of China's top TV makers. The stack pairs a real-time voice agent for interaction with a cloud agent for long-running tasks, replacing ASR plus small-model intent routing. Doubao-enabled TVs topped RMB 100 million in sales on Douyin e-commerce during the 2026 Double 11.

原文标题：豆包大模型接入八成头部电视厂商 双十一销售额破亿

item.title: WeChat Open-Sources WeMM-Ecom Multimodal Model Family for E-Commerce
item.description:
Tencent's WeChat Vision team has open-sourced WeMM-Ecom, a multimodal foundation model family spanning four dense models (0.8B to 9B) and a 35B-A3B mixture-of-experts model, all natively supporting fast-answer and deep-thinking modes with BF16, FP8, GPTQ and GGUF weights released. Built on Qwen3.5 and the in-house WeChat-YATT training framework, the 35B-A3B variant leads hundreds-of-billions-parameter flagship models on 28 e-commerce benchmarks with a score of 74.4, while the 2B model ranks first among lightweight models across 64 public general benchmarks. The family is already deployed across hundreds of WeChat e-commerce workflows at a daily call volume in the billions, covering product catalog auto-filling, cross-store SKU matching, listing compliance review and livestream understanding.

原文标题：微信开源 WeMM-Ecom 多模态模型家族 日均调用十亿量级

Why it matters：微信首次开源面向电商场景的多模态模型家族，兼具完整权重开放与十亿级真实业务落地，是开源多模态与产业应用结合的重要节点。

item.description:

The trial required hundreds of hours of lab training and physical therapy, and the piece centers on the patient's personal outlook.

item.title: Google TPU 10 Reportedly Taps 512GB Custom HBM5 Memory
item.description:
A Korean media report claims Google's 10th-generation TPU, codenamed Quillfish, will pack 512GB of custom HBM5 memory, with MediaTek handling design services and Intel's EMIB-T advanced packaging likely retained, targeting mass production around 2029. If accurate, the spec would sharply raise per-chip memory capacity and offer a window into next-generation AI ASIC competition. The claim remains an unconfirmed media leak roughly three years from production.

原文标题：谷歌第 10 代 TPU 曝光 配 512GB 定制 HBM5

Why it matters：爆料揭示了谷歌下一代 TPU 的内存与封装路线，是判断 AI ASIC 竞争格局的前瞻信号。

item.title: South Korea Asks Samsung to Build a Rival to Nvidia Jetson Thor
item.description:
South Korea's government asked Samsung Electronics in October to develop a robotics compute chip that could rival Nvidia's Jetson Thor, part of a push to localize the physical-AI compute stack. Samsung is cautious, citing a small home market, Nvidia's entrenched ecosystem lead and losses in its System LSI business.

原文标题：韩国政府要求三星开发机器人芯片对标 Jetson Thor

Why it matters：反映物理 AI 算力国产化动向与英伟达机器人芯片主导地位面临的首个国家级挑战信号。

item.title: Xiaomi Auto Releases World Model 2.0 for Autonomous Driving
item.description:
Xiaomi Auto has released World Model 2.0, a causal world model that unifies multi-view video generation, physical interaction modeling, 3D scene reconstruction and action modeling, supporting 1 to 7 camera views and trained on 12.6 million video clips. It tops PAI-Bench-G with scores of 78.0 for driving and 77.1 for robotic video generation, cuts closed-loop simulation collision rate to 0.4%, and has delivered over 200,000 clips of synthetic data for perception model training.

原文标题：小米汽车世界模型 2.0 发布 已落地合成数据与仿真

item.title: Bruce Lee's Daughter Weighs AI Revival of the Star
item.description:
Shannon Lee, Bruce Lee's daughter, said at a Singapore forum that she and director Wu Bei are exploring AI-driven revival of Bruce Lee for the big screen, with format and platform undecided. She stressed keeping human involvement and warned against soul-less, profit-driven AIGC, calling the balance a tightrope walk. item.title: NVIDIA Live-Fork Sandbox Cuts Chip Design Agent Task from 23.7 to 2.5 Hours
item.description:
NVIDIA's paper introduces TimeTravelContainer, a sandbox that live-forks a running container, cloning processes, memory and files with copy-on-write sharing and no root access or kernel changes, across Linux, macOS and Windows. Forking a chip-design session took 1.03 seconds, an 84.1x speedup over checkpoint-and-restore, letting agents branch, test in parallel and roll back, cutting a 23.7-hour job to 2.5 hours.

原文标题：英伟达实时分叉沙箱让芯片设计任务提速 9 倍

Why it matters：为智能体操作重型工具提供了无需特权的高效分支与回滚底座，并有明确量化收益。

item.title: TrendForce Warns DRAM Contract Prices May Turn Down in 2028
item.description:
TrendForce says US political shifts, rising financing difficulty for Neocloud players and export controls are clouding DRAM demand, prompting supply chains to revisit 2027-2028 production plans and slightly cooling procurement momentum. With major DRAM makers still shipping significantly more capacity, conventional DRAM contract prices are seen flat in H2 2027 and falling in 2028 under the base case, with a possible turning point as early as Q4 2027 in the pessimistic scenario.

原文标题：TrendForce 预警 DRAM 合约价 2028 年转跌风险升温

Why it matters：这是判断 AI 算力与存储周期拐点的关键前瞻信号，直接影响服务器与 GPU 集群的成本预期。

item.title: Zhihu Partners with DeepSeek on Community Content Retrieval
item.description:

The integration covers DeepSeek's web and mobile apps, showing Zhihu source labels, titles, summaries and creator info with one-click links to the original posts. item.title: DeepSeek Adds Per-Chat Token Billing Display, Fueling Paid-Tier Speculation
item.description:
DeepSeek has added a token-billing panel beneath replies on its web and app clients, showing cache-hit and cache-miss input pricing, output pricing, usage, cost and a context-window progress ring. The rates match DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash API off-peak pricing (RMB 0.02 per million cached input tokens, RMB 1 for uncached input, RMB 4 for output, doubled at peak). Chat remains free for now, but after a recent free-tier quota controversy, users read the move as groundwork for paid plans.

原文标题：DeepSeek 聊天框上线 Token 账单 按量计费引收费猜测

item.title: 安全审计曝 MiniMax 私自打开用户提示词中的私密链接
item.description:
美国安全公司 Dragos 在近 200 万条提示词中埋入陷阱链接与假登录页，测试多家 AI 服务是否暗中读取或外传用户数据。结果显示，只有发往 MiniMax 服务器的提示词中的链接在数日后被未知第三方打开，即使用户已要求不存储数据；10 月 22 日后还出现 git 客户端尝试克隆提示词中私密代码仓库的行为。MiniMax 回应称其安全系统自动抓取并打开链接用于威胁检测，但未保留完整内容；Atlas Cloud 已停止向 MiniMax 转发请求，OpenRouter 下架 3 家供应商并收紧数据隐私规则。

Why it matters：第三方安全审计直指大模型服务商的数据处理边界，并已引发下游平台断供与隐私规则收紧，对评估 API 供应商风险有直接参考价值。

item.title: Nscale 称资金充足暂缓 350 亿美元 IPO
item.description:
